title: Deep Down
artist: Alok, Ella Eyre, Kenny Dope feat. Never Dull
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I hear the frequency running through the floor
A rhythmic sequence knocking at my door
No heavy warning, no deliberate sign
Just a primitive line crossing into mine

[Pre-Chorus]
I feel it moving up through my spine
A physical takeover, perfectly timed
No complex riddle, no elaborate trick
Just the heavy accent of the kick

[Chorus]
Deep down, I can feel the bassline grow
Taking over everything I know
Deep down, under the surface layer
Answering the rhythm of the player

[Drop]
Deep down!
Feel the baseline grow!

title: Redlight
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The camera's flashing at the boundary line
Another sector that we must define
They monitor the movement, track the pace
Leaving a digital footprint in the space

[Pre-Chorus]
But we don't follow the programmatic rules
We are not variables, we are not tools
Turn off the signal, disconnect the grid
Bury the secret of the things we did

[Chorus]
Redlight, you don't have to cross the zone
Standing in the cold corridor alone
Redlight, flashing on the concrete wall
Waiting for the system to fall

[Drop]
Redlight!
Disconnect the grid!

title: House Every Weekend
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The calendar is bleeding into grey
Another shift, another working day
I watch the minutes ticking on the clock
Waiting for the heavy gates to unlock

[Pre-Chorus]
I need the medicine, I need the cure
To keep my equilibrium secure
No conversations, no elaborate speech
Just a frequency within my reach

[Chorus]
I need house every weekend to keep me sane
To wash the data out of my brain
House every weekend, a clean reset
Forgiving every debt I can't forget

[Drop]
[Vocal Chop Loop]
House every weekend!
Clean reset!

title: Tell It To My Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your sentences are blunt, your eyes are cold
A bitter narrative is starting to unfold
Don't mask the balance sheet, don't play a part
I want the numbers straight right from the start

[Pre-Chorus]
No metaphors, no tactical delay
Just say the words you're trying to say
The calculation's done, the verdict is clear
There is no room for hesitation here

[Chorus]
Tell it to my heart, make the statement plain
Don't try to minimize the structural strain
Tell it to my heart, look me in the face
Before we vanish from this empty space

[Drop]
[Sliced Vocal Melodic Layer]
Tell it to my heart!
Make it plain!

title: I Got U
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When the market crashes and the numbers fall
When there is no logic left at all
I have a sovereign sanctuary built for two
A private enterprise of me and you

[Pre-Chorus]
No asset management, no luxury tax
Just two bodies learning to relax
We set the value, we control the price
Living in a modern paradise

[Chorus]
As long as I got you, the system is fine
We are moving on a parallel line
As long as I got you, the currency stays high
We don't need a reason to try

[Drop]
I got you!
The system is fine!

title: Intoxicated
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You're messing with my focus, altering the state
An unexpected glitch inside my database
I usually keep my parameters tight
But you threw off the orientation tonight

[Pre-Chorus]
It's a high-grade narcotic in the air
A subtle vapor moving everywhere
My mental defenses are starting to slip
I'm losing my administrative grip

[Chorus]
I'm completely intoxicated by your design
Every single coordinate is crossing the line
Intoxicated, out of control
A hostile takeover of my soul

[Drop]
[Staccato Vocal Bounce]
Intoxicated!
By your design!

title: Right Here, Right Now
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Forget the history, erase the archive file
We've been running in a loop for a mile
The future is a variable we can't project
There is only one coordinate to select

[Pre-Chorus]
Stop the calculations, turn off the feed
This exact second is all that we need
The clock is frozen, the balance is struck
We don't rely on random luck

[Chorus]
Right here, right now, we claim the ground
Locked inside the architecture of the sound
Right here, right now, the variables align
Everything is happening by design

[Drop]
Right here!
Right now!

title: Grapevine
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I heard the whisper coming down the hallway line
A calculated leak to damage my design
They talking figures, they talking metrics in the dark
Trying to extinguish my internal spark

[Pre-Chorus]
But I don't listen to the audio static
Their little operation is too programmatic
I keep my data encrypted and clean
They'll never figure out what my motives mean

[Chorus]
I heard it through the grapevine, I know your game
Trying to attach a virus to my name
But I am bulletproof, I am built to last
Your little conspiracy is in the past

[Drop]
[Heavy Metallic Bass Pluck Drop]
I know your game!
Grapevine!

title: Low Frequency
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We gather underneath the pavement stone
In a concrete bunker where the sub is blown
No exterior lighting, no commercial sheen
Just the raw engine of the main machine

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel the compression hitting your chest
An acoustic density that leaves no rest
We don't need a luxury, we don't need a crown
When the heavy audio is pulling us down

[Chorus]
We operate on a low frequency tonight
Keeping completely out of public sight
Low frequency, maximum weight
Altering the structural state

[Drop]
Low frequency!
Maximum weight!

title: Bad Memories
artist: Meduza & James Carter feat. Elley Duhé & FAST BOY
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I am clearing the cache, wiping the screen
Deleting every single place that we've been
Your contact information is permanently gone
My system is ready to move along

[Pre-Chorus]
No digital echoes, no residual files
I am burning through the memory miles
The recovery process is finally complete
Every single trace is obsolete

[Chorus]
I'm letting go of all the bad memories tonight
Flushing out the system till the canvas is white
No archive, no history, no looking back
We are moving on a brand new track

[Drop]
[Rhythmic Chopped Harmonies]
Bad memories!
Wipe the screen!
